title: FinancialTransformer: code for "Does Regime-Gated Attention Help Stock Return Prediction? A Leakage-Controlled, Pre-Registered Evaluation"
description: Code, pre-registration, research log, audit and summary results for "Does Regime-Gated Attention Help Stock Return Prediction? A Leakage-Controlled, Pre-Registered Evaluation" (arXiv:2606.29347). Version 2 supersedes version 1, whose reported results were not supported by its experiments; see AUDIT.md. The out-of-sample predictions and model checkpoints are attached to the corresponding GitHub release. Raw price data are not redistributed; the included scripts download them from Yahoo Finance.
